    type F<T> = {} & (
        T extends [any, ...any[]]
            ? { [K in keyof T]?: F<T[K]> }
            : T extends any[]
                ? F<T[number]>[]
                : T extends { [K: string]: any }
                    ? { [K in keyof T]?: F<T[K]> }
                    : { x: string }
    );
    
    declare function f<T = any>(): F<T>;
    
    function g() {
        return f() as F<any>;
    }
